 Video Promo for the Final Episode of VISIONQUEST Teases "One Final Surprise"
 TV Trailer 
 VisionQuest Marvel MCU Disney+ Image Safe 
 about 2 days ago by Jessica Fisher 
 Marvel has released a promo for the final episode of VisionQuest , which is just days away now. The video promises “one final surprise,” which is teased when we see Tommy Maximoff ( Ruaridh Mollica ) walk into a room of candles, but we don’t see what else (or who) is inside. 
 Of course, this leads us to believe that he is likely to be united with either his brother, Billy ( Joe Locke ), or his mother, Wanda ( Elizabeth Olsen ).
 There are other threads that need to be tied up as well in the finale, and I am excited to see how it all comes together! This has been a great series, and a great finale to the trilogy that began with WandaVision , and Agatha All Along . Vision and Wanda have been two of my favorite characters in the MCU, and their story has been so interesting to see unfold. 
 Check out the promo below, and watch episode 8 of VisionQuest on Disney+ this Tuesday, November 10th.
 One Vision. One moment. One final surprise. 
Don’t miss the season finale of Marvel Television’s #VisionQuest, streaming Tuesday at 6PM PT only on Disney+. https://t.co/D6m9k2gowa
— Marvel Studios (@MarvelStudios) November 5, 2026
